# FinancialNow

> Plain-English personal finance basics: emergency funds, budgeting with the 50/30/20 rule, credit scores, debt payoff, index funds, and 401(k) vs IRA.

FinancialNow.org is an independent educational site. Content is general information, not financial, tax, or legal advice. Contribution limits and tax rules change; readers are pointed to IRS.gov for current figures.

## Pages

- [Home](https://financialnow.org/): Learn personal finance basics: build an emergency fund, budget with 50/30/20, raise your credit score, pay off debt, and start investing for retirement.
- [Emergency fund guide: how much to save and where to keep it](https://financialnow.org/emergency-fund-guide): How to size, build, and store a cash cushion for job loss, car repairs, and medical bills.
- [The 50/30/20 budget rule: a simple way to split your paycheck](https://financialnow.org/50-30-20-budget-rule): Divide after-tax income into needs, wants, and savings, with a worked example and adjustments.
- [How credit scores work and how to raise yours](https://financialnow.org/how-credit-scores-work): The five FICO factors, score ranges, free credit reports, and practical steps to improve your score.
- [Debt avalanche vs debt snowball: which payoff method is right for you?](https://financialnow.org/debt-avalanche-vs-snowball): Compare highest-rate-first and smallest-balance-first payoff with a real worked example.
- [Index fund investing basics: a beginner's guide](https://financialnow.org/index-fund-investing-basics): What index funds are, why costs matter so much, and how to start investing in them.
- [401(k) vs IRA: the differences and which to fund first](https://financialnow.org/401k-vs-ira): Compare workplace 401(k)s and IRAs, traditional vs Roth, and a sensible funding order.

## About

- [About FinancialNow](https://financialnow.org/about): FinancialNow is an independent educational site explaining budgeting, saving, credit, debt payoff, and investing basics in plain English, with no sales pitch.
- [Contact](https://financialnow.org/contact): How to reach FinancialNow by email (hello@financialnow.org).
- [Privacy policy](https://financialnow.org/privacy): What little data the site collects and how it is used.
